mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) can potentiate sympathomimetic effects and may increase cardiac sensitivity to digoxin, elevating risk of arrhythmias; phenelzine may also inhibit digoxin metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor closely for cardiac arrhythmias, digoxin toxicity signs, and blood pressure; consider alternative antidepressant; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
